# GenuDo

> Genuine AI employees for every team — agents grounded in your knowledge, with tools, channels and pipelines, that reply, act and close work across WhatsApp, Instagram, webchat and email, 24/7.

GenuDo turns your playbooks into reusable AI employees: an agent shaped with a
persona, model and guardrails, grounded in your knowledge, connected to your
tools, put to work on your channels through a pipeline — with humans in control
via a shared inbox. The site is available in English (`/en`) and Egyptian
Arabic (`/ar`). Base URL: https://genudo.ai

## Product
- [Product overview](https://genudo.ai/en/product): Knowledge, tools, channels and pipelines in one workspace.
- [AI Agents & employees](https://genudo.ai/en/ai-employees): Shape AI employees with persona, model and guardrails.
- [Knowledge Base](https://genudo.ai/en/knowledge): Ground answers in your files, tables and websites.
- [Smart model selection](https://genudo.ai/en/models): Auto-route each task to the best-fit AI model.
- [Pipeline](https://genudo.ai/en/pipelines): Conversations advance deals through stages automatically.
- [Stages & Actions](https://genudo.ai/en/stages): Define stages, entry conditions and automated actions.
- [Follow-ups](https://genudo.ai/en/followups): Sequenced, per-stage follow-ups so leads never go cold.
- [Inbox & channels](https://genudo.ai/en/channels): One shared inbox across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram, webchat and email.
- [Contacts](https://genudo.ai/en/contacts): One enriched record per customer.
- [Analytics Center](https://genudo.ai/en/analytics): Outcomes, workload, funnel and cost per outcome.
- [Integrations](https://genudo.ai/en/integrations): 40+ integrations — CRMs, calendars, sheets, Zapier, Make, n8n.
- [API & MCP](https://genudo.ai/en/api-mcp): Build GenuDo into your product via API and an MCP server.

## Solutions (AI employees)
- [AI Sales Agent](https://genudo.ai/en/sol-sales-agent): Qualify, follow up and close inbound leads 24/7.
- [AI Customer Service](https://genudo.ai/en/sol-customer-service): Answer and resolve across every channel, around the clock.
- [AI Operations Assistant](https://genudo.ai/en/sol-operations): Run routine operations behind the scenes.
